# iothub_configuration (List Resource)

Lists every configuration of the hub for `terraform query` (`GET /configurations`, filtered by content kind).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All automatic device management configurations of the hub.
list "iothub_configuration" "all" {
  provider = iothub

  config {}
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hostname` (String) IoT Hub hostname (`<hub>.azure-devices.net`) this object lives in. Defaults to the provider's `hostname`. Setting it here lets one provider block manage several hubs and lets you reference a hub that does not exist yet (`azurerm_iothub.x.hostname`).
